svg.text: poesys.
An autonomous UK energy supplier, run inside a faithful simulation of the real market.
Mission: “We are creating enterprise value by automating ways to find individual customers we can
create value for, and sharing in that value — by saving them money, time and carbon, through personalised
modelling, tariffs and advice.”
The test on every line: could a real supplier know this?

a.text: THE GOVERNANCE — ONE HUMAN, THE REST IS AI

svg.text: builds and steers everything below

a.text: THE WORLD — SIM GROUND TRUTH, BEHIND THE WALL
as they were — the 2021–22 crisis too.
Drawn fresh every run; each home hides
its finances, life events, and a thermal
home under local weather. Dual fuel.
The world moves ahead of the books: settlement lands months late. Ground truth never crosses the wall.
Cohorts drawn for learning value, not headcount.
The founder book is the production shape.
Seed families: small books side by side on distinct
seeds — a stated question, the smallest run.

svg.text: out

a.text: Ground truth never crosses. Everything else is an interface flow — in one of two directions.
— the company touches the world only through what it sends
Forecast error is the wall on the future · discovery-through-behaviour is the wall on the customer
THE COMPANY — SEES ONLY THROUGH THE WALL
serve & converse — always on, woven through every step: sales · queries · care · collections
One integrated, fully agentic stack grown end to end — trading · finance · billing · CRM · operations · debt.
Bills run on three clocks — billed / settled / banked — and the truth arrives months behind the money.
Payment and debt engine · next best action _ in build
“Payment, credit risk and forward cash forecasting are the heart of this business.”
One forward cash forecast per customer drives provision, drift limits and plans.
The company clusters its book from observables only, scored on worst-cell belief-vs-truth.
It forms beliefs, prices against them, and must live with being wrong.
It can be wrong, and it must not be guaranteed to live — collateral does not press yet.
The household is saved in three currencies: money, time and carbon. £/tCO₂e is an internal diagnostic.

svg.text: NOW — PHASE 1, BUILD
EVOLVES INTO — ADAPT, FORWARD
2016–25 record replayed; weather → demand
Curriculum-drawn cohorts, protected tails
UK-compliant billing on three clocks · collections
Tier-1 bill accuracy · assets on anchored S-curves
Household half-hourly CO₂ measured
A rival that defends: renewals meet its price
Payment and debt engine · next best action
Life events: moves, income shocks, deaths
Its own randomised holdout, read
Conversations v1: write, respond, score the gap
Naive forward belief it must outgrow
Abatement: no counterfactual yet
Time, household minutes: not yet instrumented
The harness itself — a product in its own right
. done _ in build ~ not started (the map)
Scenario worlds: crisis-replay, glut, tail-heavy
Traded product ladder; rivals that contest
Collateral→cash death loop (2021–22 replay)
The rest of the state layer: births, divorce
Price-sensitivity discovered, never tagged
Holdout-measured uplift: proven, not asserted
Abatement measured: CO₂ a home did not emit
Phase 2: learns within a run
Phase 3: runs past the record, trends unseen
Endgame: whole lives rerun to death or endpoint
— the fitness function is open until Phase 3 (§2).
Anything claimed as working carries its proof —
level, test, or gap named.
Anything here stated as present tense anywhere
on the site is a claim-status defect.
